title: periods.chain
description: Consecutive periodic runs of a subscription: the first `count` billing days on or after from_date (BE-SP-30..32 predicate, run at local noon) and the boundaries each run bills (BE-SP-37). Every element carries billing_date, from_datetime, to_datetime, charges_from_datetime, charges_to_datetime and period_days, as op periods.boundaries computes them at that run (charges bounds null when absent, BE-SP-18); vectors usually list a subset of the keys (expected is a subset).

timezone.description: Effective time zone of the customer (BE-DM-10).

from_date.description: First local date from which billing days are searched.
